title: Chemers Neustein Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowship Program (SURF)
field: Laboratory research at The Rockefeller University
about: The Rockefeller University's summer undergraduate research programme in New York, United States runs June 7 to August 13, 2027 for college sophomores and juniors; international students may apply. Applications and recommendation letters are due February 1, 2027.
requirements: International students are eligible to apply
Online application, personal statement, official transcript, two recommendation letters, CV
